blocks.text:
`Gtk::TreeView` is deprecated since gtkmm 4.10.
In new code, use `Gtk::ListView` for lists and
`Gtk::ColumnView` for tabular lists.
blocks.zh: `Gtk::TreeView` 自 gtkmm 4.10 起已弃用：新代码里，列表用 `Gtk::ListView`，表格式列表用 `Gtk::ColumnView`。

blocks.text:
The `Gtk::TreeView` widget can contain lists or trees of
data, in columns.
blocks.zh: Gtk::TreeView部件的每一行都可以包含数据列表或数据树。

blocks.text:
Each `Gtk::TreeView` has an associated
`Gtk::TreeModel`, which contains the data displayed by the
`TreeView`. Each `Gtk::TreeModel` can
be used by more than one `Gtk::TreeView`. For instance,
this allows the same underlying data to be displayed and edited in 2 different
ways at the same time. Or the 2 Views might display different columns from the
same Model data, in the same way that 2 SQL queries (or "views") might
show different fields from the same database table.
blocks.zh: 每个 `Gtk::TreeView` 都有一个关联的 `Gtk::TreeModel`，存放 `TreeView` 显示的数据。同一个 `Gtk::TreeModel` 可以被多个 `Gtk::TreeView` 使用：同一份数据可同时以两种不同方式显示与编辑，或两个视图显示同一 Model 数据的不同列——就像两条 SQL 查询访问同一个数据库。

blocks.text:
Although you can theoretically implement your own Model, you will normally use
either the `ListStore` or `TreeStore`
model classes.
blocks.zh: 理论上你可以实现自己的模型，但通常情况直接使用ListStore或TreeStore可以省略很多麻烦。

blocks.text: [Reference](&url_refdocs_base_gtk_html;classGtk_1_1TreeModel.html)
ListStore, for rows

The `ListStore` contains simple rows of data, and each row
has no children.
blocks.zh: ListStore包含简单的数据行，每个行都没有孩子。

blocks.text: TreeView - ListStore
[Reference](&url_refdocs_base_gtk_html;classGtk_1_1ListStore.html)
TreeStore, for a hierarchy

The `TreeStore` contains rows of data, and each row may
have child rows.
blocks.zh: TreeStore包含数据行，并且每一行都可能有子行。

blocks.text: TreeView - TreeStore
[Reference](&url_refdocs_base_gtk_html;classGtk_1_1TreeStore.html)
Model Columns

The `TreeModelColumnRecord` class is used to keep track
of the columns and their data types. You add
`TreeModelColumn` instances to the
`ColumnRecord` and then use those
`TreeModelColumn`s when getting and setting the data in
model rows. You will probably find it convenient to derive a new
`TreeModelColumnRecord` which has your
`TreeModelColumn` instances as member data.
blocks.zh: TreeModelColumnRecord用于跟踪列和它们的数据类型。你TreeModelColumn实例添加到ColumnRecord，然后使用那些TreeModelColumns获取和设置模型列中的数据。你可能会发现，派生一个你自己的包含有TreeModelColumn数据成员的TreeModelColumnRecord会更方便。

blocks.text:
You specify the `ColumnRecord` when creating the Model,
like so:
blocks.zh: 你可以在创建模型的时候指定ColumnRecord，如下所示：

blocks.text:
Glib::RefPtr<Gtk::ListStore> refListStore =
    Gtk::ListStore::create(m_Columns);

As a `TreeModelColumnRecord` describes structure, not data,
it can be shared among multiple models, and this is preferable for efficiency.
However, the instance (such as `m_Columns` here) should usually
not be static, because it often needs to be instantiated after
`glibmm` has been initialized. The best solution is
to make it a lazily instantiated singleton, so that it will be constructed
on-demand, whenever the first model accesses it.
blocks.zh: TreeModelColumnRecord描述的是结构而不是数据，它可以在多个模型之间共享，这样效率更高。但是实例（例如此处的m_Columns）通常不是静态的，因为通常需要在glibmm初始化后示例化它。最好的解决方案是使他成为惰性初始化的单例，以便在第一个模型访问他的时候按需构造。

blocks.text: Adding Rows

Add rows to the model with the append(),
prepend(), or insert() methods.
blocks.zh: 使用append()、prepend()或insert()方法可以向模型添加行。

blocks.text: auto iter = m_refListStore->append();
You can dereference the iterator to get the Row:
blocks.zh: 你可以通过解引用迭代器获得行：

blocks.text: auto row = *iter;
Adding child rows

`Gtk::TreeStore` models can have child items. Add them
with the append(), prepend(), or
insert() methods, like so:
blocks.zh: Gtk::TreeStore模型可以存在子物件。可以通过append()、prepend()或insert()方法添加，如下所示：

blocks.text:
auto iter_child =
    m_refTreeStore->append(row.children());
Setting values

You can use the operator[] overload to set the data for a
particular column in the row, specifying the
`TreeModelColumn` used to create the model.
blocks.zh: 你可以使用operator[]重载设置行中的特定列的数据，你需要使用创建模型时的TreeModelColumn指定列。

blocks.text: row[m_Columns.m_col_text] = "sometext";
Getting values

You can use the operator[] overload to get the data in a
particular column in a row, specifying the
`TreeModelColumn` used to create the model.
blocks.zh: 你可以使用operator[]重载获取行中特定列的数据，你需要使用创建模型时的TreeModelColumn指定列。

blocks.text:
auto strText = row[m_Columns.m_col_text];
auto number = row[m_Columns.m_col_number];

The compiler will complain if you use an inappropriate type. For
instance, this would generate a compiler error:
blocks.zh: 如果你使用了不合适的类型，编译器会报错。例如，编译器将生成一个编译错误：

blocks.text:
//compiler error - no conversion from ustring to int.
int number = row[m_Columns.m_col_text];
"Hidden" Columns

You might want to associate extra data with each row. If so, just add
it as a Model column, but don't add it to the View.
blocks.zh: 你可能想要将额外的数据和每一行关联。如果是这样，你只需要将其添加到模型的一个行中而不将其添加到视图中即可。
